name: Southern Illinois University Edwardsville
overview:
Southern Illinois University Edwardsville (SIUE)

Accredited by the Higher Learning Commission of the North Central Association of Colleges and Schools, SIUE is a university offering more than 350 undergraduate, graduate, and doctoral areas of study.


The campus is located in Edwardsville, Illinois, and is well-known for its welcoming and friendly environment. Spread over 10 square kilometers, the campus provides every necessary commodity on site.


Located in the Midwest, SIUE is only 25 minutes from St. Louis and within reach of Chicago, making it conveniently situated for accessing major city centers.


Nationally recognized for its excellence:

  • SIUE is listed as one of the top business schools in the US.
  • It has received the Higher Education Excellence in Diversity Award, which is of particular interest to international students.
administrative:
1. Application Dossier

You will work directly with the partner university regarding your application. All required documents must be uploaded on their platform or sent by email before the deadline. (See the Americas Teams channel for each application deadline.). If you have not received anything yet, it means your nomination has not been sent yet — please be patient.


In the past, the partner has requested the following:

  • The completed application form
  • Proof of English proficiency: A Tepitech score certificate in English
  • Proof of financial eligibility:
  • Students must show proof of funds for education and living expenses for the duration of their studies at SF State.
  • Acceptable documents:
  • Bank statement, financial statement, or letter from your bank
  • Must reflect a minimum balance of $20,000 USD
  • Documents must be less than 6 months old
  • A copy of your passport


This information is subject to change by the partner university. They will provide you with the most current information upon your acceptance.


To be given to the Epitech bachelor campus administration to reenroll for Tech4 (in April/May):

  • The addendum to the contract
  • The EPITECH re-registration dossier


2. Visa (more information here)

You can find all the detailed information on the US government website or the Embassy of the US in Paris website. You can check the deadlines for obtaining an appointment here.


1. Admission letter and I-20 form

Once you are admitted by the host university, SIUE will send you your admission package with your acceptance letter and original documents for your visa. Please check the information on I-20 carefully and sign the document.


2. Pay the SEVIS fees

 You must then pay the SEVIS I-901 fees online (here). Make sure you print the receipts. The fees for students are $350.


3.Complete the DS-160 form

Complete DS-160 form and upload an ID photo meeting the following requirements. Print the application form confirmation page to bring to your interview.

You will have to pay a visa application fee (non refundable) before your interview of $185 (more information here).


4.Schedule an appointment at the consulate

For people in France, you need to make an appointment for your interview at the US Consulate. Plan to travel to Paris for it.

If you live in another country, check the different consulate/embassy.


During your interview at the consulate, you must:

  • have the necessary supporting documents to prove that you qualify for the category of visa that you request--document relating to your current studies and its relationship to the studies you wish to pursue in the United States: academic transcript, various certificates, SAT or TOEFL test scores, diplomas, etc.
  • demonstrate, with supporting evidence, to the consular officer that you have solid family, social and financial ties to France and that you intend to return there once your residence permit has expired.
  • prove that you have the financial means necessary to finance your studies and live in good conditions in the United States for the first 12 months. Any document proving your family or relational ties with any person funding your studies, as well as bank statements, tax notices thereof.

Please note that the visa gives you the right to work 20 hours on campus.


3. Insurance and Health (more information here and here)

SIUE has secured a medical health insurance policy for all international students. This is the only acceptable health insurance plan for international students attending SIUE. The University Student Insurance Committee coordinated the premium and plan benefits through Academic Health Plans. 


All international students are required to enroll in the plan if they are enrolled in (1) or more credit hours or are enrolled in University 500. The credit hours can be on-campus or off-campus. Your Bursar bill will automatically include this fee. Insurance cost for international students per semester: $1,200


Additionally, specific immunizations are required for all international students (notably for Tuberculosis (TB).


It is recommended that you complete them before arrival. If your immunization records are not in English, they must be accompanied by a certified translation. Immunizations required upon arrival will cost $75–$200.


4. Prepare your arrival

Read more about the university here.

Check the International Student Checklist provided by the university here.
accomodation:
On-campus accommodation (more information here)

Students may live in on-campus housing. Two main options are available:

  • Evergreen Hall
  • Website: siue.edu/housing/housing-options/evergreen/index.shtml
  • Cougar Village Apartments
  • Website: siue.edu/housing/housing-options/cougar-village/index.shtml

Students must be admitted to SIUE before applying for University Housing.


You'll apply online and pay the following fees: $50 application fee (non-refundable) with a $75 deposit.


For international payments: complete the housing application until the payment screen. Instead of paying through the application, submit payment via Flywire (processing may take up to one business week). You will be notified when the payment is received.


Housing Costs per Semester (more information here)

  • Shared Bedroom: $3,380
  • Single Bedroom: $3,825
  • Private Apartment: $4,810


The Preferred Application Deadlines are the following:

  • Fall/Spring academic term: May 1
  • Spring semester only: December 1
  • Summer semester: May 1

cost:
Financial Overview (4th year Epitech)

  • You must pay the tuition fees for the 4th year of EPITECH, as well as the re-registration fees and related fees.
  • EPITECH covers the tuition fees. Epitech covers tuition only for required credits.
  • The tuition supplement payable by you is indicated at the top of this page (if applicable).
  • Other costs at your expense include: travel, accommodation on site, insurance, and everyday expenses (books, food, transport, etc.).


Other Expenses / Estimated Budget (more information here)


The local currency is the Dollar. 1 € = 1.16USD (rate as of October 2025).

Please check the Numbeo website to compare the cost of living between your city of origin and your city of exchange. Please note that everyone's budget will be different according to one's lifestyle.


  • Roundtrip flights: about 1000€ depending on the airline & travel dates
  • Insurance: 2500$/year
  • Visa: about 500€
  • Books and supplies: 1000$/year

  • Transportation: 1600$/year

These prices are indicative and may vary.
